sentences.en: We get support from UC Davis, a globally ranked university working to solve the world's most pressing problems in food, energy, health, education, and the environment.
sentences.zh: 我们得到了加州大学戴维斯分校的支持，这是一所全球知名的大学，致力于解决世界在食品、能源、健康、教育和环境领域最紧迫的问题。

sentences.en: UC Davis researchers collaborate and innovate in California and around the globe to find transformational solutions.
sentences.zh: 加州大学戴维斯分校的研究人员在加州乃至全球范围内合作创新，寻找变革性的解决方案。

sentences.en: It's all part of the university's mission to promote quality of life for all living things.
sentences.zh: 这一切都是该大学旨在提升所有生命生活质量的使命的一部分。

sentences.en: Find out more at 21stCentury.UCDavis.edu.
sentences.zh: 了解更多信息请访问 21stCentury.UCDavis.edu。

sentences.en: This is 99% Invisible.
sentences.zh: 这里是“99%隐形”。

sentences.en: I'm Roman Mars.
sentences.zh: 我是罗曼·马尔斯。

sentences.en: The details are not the details.
sentences.zh: 细节不只是细节。

sentences.en: They make the design.
sentences.zh: 细节成就设计。

sentences.en: That's John Edson.
sentences.zh: 那是约翰·埃德森说的。

sentences.en: That's what he said.
sentences.zh: 他是这么说的。

sentences.en: Quoting legendary designer Charles Eames.
sentences.zh: 引用传奇设计师查尔斯·埃姆斯的话。

sentences.en: Express, test, and cycle.
sentences.zh: 表达、测试、循环。

sentences.en: I'm John Edson, president of Lunar.
sentences.zh: 我是卢纳公司总裁约翰·埃德森。

sentences.en: Express, test, and cycle.
sentences.zh: 表达、测试、循环。

sentences.en: There's a conception in the public, I think, that design is a lot about making things pretty.
sentences.zh: 我想公众有一种观念，认为设计很大程度上就是把东西做得漂亮。

sentences.en: That's shifting, I think.
sentences.zh: 我想这种观念正在改变。

sentences.en: There's a big DIY movement and maker movement, and people are getting a better sense of how things come to be.
sentences.zh: 现在有一个很大的DIY运动和创客运动，人们对事物是如何诞生的有了更好的理解。

sentences.en: We've always known how kind of buildings came to be, because we'd watch them go up.
sentences.zh: 我们一直都知道建筑物是怎么建成的，因为我们可以看着它们拔地而起。

sentences.en: But products just kind of appear on the store shelf from somewhere, from China, right?
sentences.zh: 但产品不知怎么地就突然出现在商店货架上，来自某个地方，比如中国，对吧？

sentences.en: But I really love the process of design and love bringing things to life.
sentences.zh: 但我真的很喜欢设计的过程，也喜欢将事物赋予生命。

sentences.en: Express, test, and cycle.
sentences.zh: 表达、测试、循环。

sentences.en: The story that I want to tell about the details that go into product making is about a toothbrush.
sentences.zh: 我想讲述的产品制造背后的细节故事，是关于一把牙刷的。

sentences.en: But there's a bit of a conflict of interest, or at least the perception of one, that requires a disclaimer.
sentences.zh: 但这里有点利益冲突，或者说至少存在这种感觉，因此需要作个免责声明。

sentences.en: So I asked Matt Martin at KLW to help me out.
sentences.zh: 所以我请KALW的马特·马丁来帮我一把。

sentences.en: What matters to me, Roman, is that you are completely open about the fact that John Edson is the president of Lunar.
sentences.zh: 罗曼，对与我而言重要的是，你必须完全坦诚地说明约翰·埃德森是卢纳公司的总裁这一事实。

sentences.en: Lunar underwrites these segments, but at the same time, you've got complete editorial control over how 99% invisible sounds.
sentences.zh: 卢纳公司赞助了这些环节，但与此同时，你对“99%隐形”的声音拥有完全的编辑控制权。

sentences.en: So what do you think you're going to say?
sentences.zh: 那你觉得你会说些什么？

sentences.en: Oh, I'll think of something.
sentences.zh: 哦，我会想出点什么来的。

sentences.en: You know, what he said.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，正如他所说。

sentences.en: This is the story of a toothbrush.
sentences.zh: 这是一个关于牙刷的故事。

sentences.en: Express.
sentences.zh: 表达。

sentences.en: Expressing is getting a design out there in the world in a prototype form so that other people can look at it.
sentences.zh: 表达是指以原型形式将设计呈现到世界上，以便其他人可以查看它。

sentences.en: TeSt.
sentences.zh: 测试。

sentences.en: And you can test it, you can evaluate it, and then you can decide what you're going to do next.
sentences.zh: 你可以对其进行测试、评估，然后决定接下来要做什么。

sentences.en: And it really is this kind of forced evolutionary process.
sentences.zh: 这确实是一种被迫的演化过程。

sentences.en: So the toothbrush company came to Lunar with what John Edson calls a make-pretty exercise.
sentences.zh: 所以这家牙刷公司找到卢纳时，提出了约翰·埃德森所称的美化练习。

sentences.en: Make-pretty exercise.
sentences.zh: 美化练习。

sentences.en: That's not really innovation.
sentences.zh: 那其实算不上创新。

sentences.en: Our instinct was to ask them, well, how do people hold toothbrushes?
sentences.zh: 我们的直觉是问他们，人们究竟是怎么握牙刷的？

sentences.en: But the toothbrush company didn't actually know this.
sentences.zh: 但这家牙刷公司其实并不知道这一点。

sentences.en: So we engaged a hand kinesiologiSt.
sentences.zh: 于是我们聘请了一位手部运动机能学家。

sentences.en: That's somebody who knows how people hold stuff.
sentences.zh: 也就是专门研究人们如何握持物品的人。

sentences.en: It turns out there are five common toothbrush grips.
sentences.zh: 事实证明，常见的牙刷握法有五种。

sentences.en: And in the meantime, our designers went out and bought every toothbrush under the sun.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，我们的设计师出去买下了天底下所有的牙刷。

sentences.en: And we started to take the conventional flat toothbrush with bristles sticking up out of it.
sentences.zh: 我们开始拆解传统的扁平牙刷，其刷毛从刷柄上直立出来。

sentences.en: And we used a heat gun and made a bunch of different prototypes.
sentences.zh: 我们使用热风枪制作了一堆不同的原型。

sentences.en: We just bent.
sentences.zh: 我们只是进行弯曲。

sentences.en: Express.
sentences.zh: 表达。

sentences.en: Those standard brushes into different shapes to see fundamentally what was working and what was not working.
sentences.zh: 把那些标准刷子弯成不同的形状，从根本上看出什么行得通，什么行不通。

sentences.en: TeSt.
sentences.zh: 测试。

sentences.en: Hundreds of sketches and dozens of prototypes.
sentences.zh: 数百个草图和几十个原型。

sentences.en: Cycle.
sentences.zh: 循环。

sentences.en: One of the first things we found when we were molding our prototypes was that, at the time,
sentences.zh: 当我们塑造原型时发现的最早的事情之一是，在当时，

sentences.en: the Reach toothbrush was probably best known as the most ergonomic toothbrush.
sentences.zh: 雷奇牙刷可能最以最具人体工程学的牙刷而闻名。

sentences.en: This was all perception.
sentences.zh: 这全都是错觉。

sentences.en: It was only ergonomic in that it looked like a dental tool.
sentences.zh: 它之所以符合人体工程学，仅仅是因为它看起来像个牙科工具。

sentences.en: And it was a dental tool that somebody else would use on you, the crook in the dental mirror.
sentences.zh: 而且那是别人对你使用的牙科工具，也就是牙科镜子上的那个弯儿。

sentences.en: It's so that somebody can stick it in your mouth and manipulate it so they can see around your teeth.
sentences.zh: 那是为了让别人把它伸进你的嘴里并进行操作，以便他们能看清你的牙齿周围。

sentences.en: But the Reach toothbrush, if you use it yourself, you end up with your hand back at your ear.
sentences.zh: 但如果是你自己使用雷奇牙刷，你的手最后会退到耳朵旁边。

sentences.en: So scrap the bend.
sentences.zh: 所以取消弯曲。

sentences.en: Straight handle is better.
sentences.zh: 直柄更好。

sentences.en: One of the things we found was a fatter toothbrush handle is more comfortable.
sentences.zh: 我们发现的一个特点是，更粗的牙刷柄用起来更舒服。

sentences.en: So fat is better than thin.
sentences.zh: 所以粗比细好。

sentences.en: But at some point in the process, someone at the toothbrush company said,
sentences.zh: 但在过程中的某个时刻，牙刷公司的某个人说：

sentences.en: Wait a minute.
sentences.zh: 等一下。

sentences.en: We can't ship a toothbrush that's got a fat handle on it like that.
sentences.zh: 我们不能运送一把手柄那么粗的牙刷。

sentences.en: Because it's not going to fit into those 1950s style ceramic toothbrush holders that people have stuck to their walls.
sentences.zh: 因为它放不进人们粘在墙上的那种20世纪50年代风格的陶瓷牙刷架里。

sentences.en: Part of their houses, right?
sentences.zh: 那是他们房子的一部分，对吧？

sentences.en: But this turned out to be a good thing for the toothbrush mongers.
sentences.zh: 但事实证明这对牙刷销售商来说是件好事。

sentences.en: They got a ton of press about it.
sentences.zh: 他们因此获得了大量的媒体报道。

sentences.en: Oh, here's the toothbrush that doesn't fit.
sentences.zh: 哦，这就是那把放不进去的牙刷。

sentences.en: And Lunar came up with a strategy.
sentences.zh: 于是卢纳想出了一个策略。

sentences.en: If anybody called to complain, we created this little nickel-plated stand.
sentences.zh: 如果有人打电话来抱怨，我们就制作了这个镀镍的小支架。

sentences.en: They'd just send out this $5 component.
sentences.zh: 他们只需要寄出这个5美元的零件。

sentences.en: Just like biological evolution.
sentences.zh: 就像生物进化一样。

sentences.en: Sure, the organism adapts to the environment.
sentences.zh: 当然，生物会适应环境。

sentences.en: But also, the environment adapts to the organism.
sentences.zh: 但同时，环境也会适应生物。

sentences.en: And now if you buy a toothbrush holder, it's going to have these gigantic holes in the top, right?
sentences.zh: 现在如果你买个牙刷架，顶部就会有这些巨大的洞，对吧？

sentences.en: So you can fit these new fangled toothbrushes in them.
sentences.zh: 这样你就可以把这些新潮的牙刷插进去了。

sentences.en: Future-oriented.
sentences.zh: 面向未来。

sentences.en: In addition to the straight and fat handles, the new toothbrush also had crisscross bristles.
sentences.zh: 除了笔直而粗大的手柄，新牙刷还采用了交叉刷毛。

sentences.en: Angled bristles.
sentences.zh: 带角度的刷毛。

sentences.en: That was brand new.
sentences.zh: 那是全新的。

sentences.en: The handle was strategically flattened in parts to help you orient it.
sentences.zh: 手柄在某些地方进行了策略性的压扁，以帮助你辨别方向。

sentences.en: Your fingers know which way the bristles are pointed in your mouth.
sentences.zh: 你的手指能知道刷毛在嘴里指向哪个方向。

sentences.en: And it accommodated all of the five brushing grips identified by the kinesiologiSt.
sentences.zh: 它适应了运动机能学家确定的所有五种刷牙握法。

sentences.en: There's a spoon grip.
sentences.zh: 有勺式握法。

sentences.en: There's the death grip.
sentences.zh: 还有死握法。

sentences.en: More women than men use the death grip.
sentences.zh: 使用死握法的女性多于男性。

sentences.en: When I asked John Edson which was his favorite innovation in the toothbrush, he named something
sentences.zh: 当我问约翰·埃德森他对这款牙刷最喜欢哪个创新时，他提到了一点

sentences.en: that most people would consider a lack of design or innovation.
sentences.zh: 大多数人会认为那是缺乏设计或创新。

sentences.en: Just getting the toothbrush back to having a straight handle.
sentences.zh: 仅仅是让牙刷恢复直柄设计。

sentences.en: It's not trying to do anything crazy through the neck.
sentences.zh: 它没有在刷颈处做任何疯狂的尝试。

sentences.en: That's the best shape, really.
sentences.zh: 那真的是最好的形状。

sentences.en: You know, those kind of, duh, innovations.
sentences.zh: 你知道，那种显而易见的创新。

sentences.en: And that's a big part of design.
sentences.zh: 这也是设计的重要组成部分。

sentences.en: The thing you don't think about or notice probably had the most thought put into it.
sentences.zh: 那些你不会多想或注意到的东西，往往倾注了最多的心血。

sentences.en: 99% Invisible is produced by me, Roman Mars, with support from Lunar.
sentences.zh: “99%隐形”由我罗曼·马尔斯制作，并得到了卢纳公司的支持。

sentences.en: It's a project of KALW, the American Institute of Architects, San Francisco, and the Center for Architecture and Design.
sentences.zh: 这是由KALW、美国建筑师学会旧金山分会以及建筑与设计中心共同开展的项目。

sentences.en: Find out more at 99percentinvisible.org.
sentences.zh: 了解更多信息请访问 99percentinvisible.org。
